payload.basis: Synthesized from 3 parallel Composer 2.5 Fast trace-analysis subagents across 142+ transcripts (1,406 CLI calls) and human selection of keep_aa_cli + all 6 CLI optimization categories on 2026-10-14.
payload.claim: Keep adaptive-artifacts as the canonical extension/contract name while shipping a bin/aa CLI alias, and amend the CLI/runtime across six areas: (1) universal short type/view/bundle resolution across all subcommands, (2) optional --type with --id, --type+--subject targeting on get/update/supersede, default --expected-revision @current, and --expected-revision on correct, (3) single-command view file sync (view --write / sync-views) plus exempting <store>/views/*.md in validate_immutability, (4) list top-level --where, --exact-subject, expanded --order-by, and --fields/--format output, (5) get --full/--field/--body-only, repeatable -p/--set and --payload-file, and apply --file, and (6) worktree-aware store discovery plus a session_hooks guard against clobbering views when a stale plugin reads 0 records.
payload.invalidated_when: The CLI surface is replaced by an incompatible v0.4 CLI or human reverses the aa alias / 6-area optimization scope.
